T-CASE-0.action: Rotate cap to120 deg and back at30 deg/s for3 cycles.
T-CASE-0.observable: Relative angle,tether continuity and unintended collision.
T-CASE-0.pass_condition: Angle endpoints within2 deg; tether remains connected; unintended overlap <=0.2 mm.
T-CASE-0.note: Proxy acceptance conditions,not manufacturer tolerances; source requirements retain their own provenance.

T-CASE-1.initial: Cap open120 deg; 1 mm diameter,20 mm long B probe above mouth.
T-CASE-1.action: Move probe5 mm below mouth plane and withdraw10 mm; attempt ready state with cap open,then closed.
T-CASE-1.observable: Probe clearance and independent readiness predicate.
T-CASE-1.pass_condition: Collision-free approach except intended support; open-cap readiness rejected; closed-cap readiness allowed only after probe withdrawal.
T-CASE-1.note: Proxy acceptance conditions,not manufacturer tolerances; source requirements retain their own provenance.
